Peter Johnson is covering the auto industry’s step-by-step transformation to electric vehicles. He is an experienced investor, financial writer, and EV enthusiast. His enthusiasm for electric vehicles, primarily Tesla, is a significant reason he pursued a career in investments. If he isn’t telling you about his latest 10K findings, you can find him enjoying the outdoors or exercising. For questions or comments, you can email him at Peter@electrek.co . You can also follow him on Twitter @EVPeteJohnson .
BYD reveals a flashy new feature on its upcoming luxury EV
BYD is moving upmarket with its new flagship EV, featuring suicide doors, a gemstone grille, and possibly solid-state batteries.
Toyota reveals five new lifted Woodland concepts, including the bZ electric SUV
Toyota introduced a new family of lifted, “adventure-ready” Woodland concepts based on the RAV4, Grand Highlander, Sienna, Crown Signia, and bZ electric SUV.
Hyundai launches the new IONIQ 6 in the UK with up to 422 miles of range, starting at $45K
The new Hyundai IONIQ 6 is now on sale in the UK with an impressive range of up to 422 miles, starting at about $45,000.
Volkswagen hits pause on the Golf EV as it faces an ‘urgent need for action’
Volkswagen has put the electric Golf on hold for now as it faces growing pressure to cut costs.
BYD spotted testing a new minivan [Video]
BYD’s upcoming multi-purpose vehicle (MPV) was spotted on a car carrier and at one of its Flash Charging stations ahead of its expected debut later this year.
Toyota’s EV sales more than doubled in a year, but gas cars are getting crushed in China
Toyota’s EV sales have jumped 127% through September, but that isn’t telling the whole story. Slumping demand for gas and hybrid cars in China has pushed global sales lower for three months in a row.
Hyundai hints at IONIQ P as the name for its new entry-level EV
Hyundai is launching a new mass-market electric SUV to be made in India, expected to go on sale as the IONIQ P.
This $15,000 low-speed EV is now on sale, and it’s street-legal
It may be small, but it’s already drawing a big response. The 2027 Fiat Topolino is now on sale in the US: a street-legal, low-speed EV that starts under $15,000.
The Ford Escape may return as an EV based on the UEV platform [Update]
Ford pulled the plug on the Escape last year after a 25-year run, but the crossover SUV could return as an EV on the new UEV platform.
Used EVs are suddenly hot sellers — Here are the top SUVs for under $25,000
Don’t want to pay full price? Used EVs with low miles, like the Hyundai IONIQ 5 and Ford Mustang Mach-E, are selling on the secondhand market for $25,000 or less.
Volkswagen’s EV battery recall reaches over 85,000, with Audi now included
Volkswagen’s latest recall now extends to Audi, affecting nearly 13,000 Q4 E-Tron and Q4 Sportback E-Tron vehicles globally. And just like with the ID.4, owners are being told to limit charging to 80% of the battery’s capacity.
Kia’s PV5 electric campervan has two beds and a fully equipped kitchen [Images]
Kia’s electric campervan, based on the PV5 , includes two double beds, a 200 W solar panel, and a fully equipped kitchen.
CATL pushes ahead with 20 Ah solid-state EV batteries, with 500 Wh/kg in sight
CATL hit another milestone in its solid-state battery development, advancing to 20 Ah cells. The world’s leading battery maker aims to begin small-scale production in 2027.
BYD’s $10,000 EV blows a tire at nearly 90 mph — Watch what happens
BYD updated its lowest-priced electric car, the Seagull, which starts at around $10,000 in China, with a few extras, including a high-speed tire blowout system that stabilizes the vehicle at nearly 90 mph.
BMW is going upscale with its first 3-row EV, the iX7
BMW’s next electric SUV won’t just be bigger. The iX7 will sit at the top of the brand’s EV lineup when it debuts in 2027, bringing a more luxurious option to the mix.
The 2027 Kia EV9 costs $90 more, but at least you get a few extras
Kia barely touched the 2027 EV9’s price, raising it by only $90 while sneaking in a few extra standard features on select trims.
BYD names its ultra-luxury EV, and it could be a game changer next week
BYD’s new flagship EV will be its largest and most luxurious electric sedan yet, potentially debuting two firsts for the company next week: Rolls-Royce-style coach doors and solid-state batteries.
The 2027 Kia EV6 is over $8,000 more than the new EV3
Kia announced that 2027 EV6 prices start at about $38,000, or $8,000 more than the new EV3.
BMW’s new iX5 looks like a big upgrade next to the old X5 [Images]
BMW’s new iX5 is hard to miss with its distinct Double-X headlights. Here’s how it stacks up against the outgoing X5, side by side.
The 2027 Lexus RZ starts at under $50,000 and offers over 300 miles of range
The 2027 Lexus RZ will begin arriving at dealerships early next year, with prices starting at under $50,000.
BYD opens pre-orders for its first luxury electric SUV with over 1,000 km CLTC range
BYD opened pre-orders for the new Denza N8, a luxury five-seat electric SUV with a CLTC range of over 1,000 km (621 miles).
Hyundai’s $359 IONIQ 5 lease looks good, but its bigger sibling may be a better buy
The Hyundai IONIQ 5 is the most popular EV in America outside of Tesla, but its larger three-row sibling looks like the better deal right now.
Volvo is launching a ‘lower-priced’ EV in 2027 based on its SPA3 platform
The new EV will follow the EX60 as the second vehicle based on Volvo’s SPA3 platform, positioned as a smaller, more affordable option.
Volvo says the EX60 will be a best-seller with over 50,000 orders in Europe already
Volvo expects the EX60 to become one of its best-selling vehicles ever, with over 50,000 orders already in Europe. But as demand builds, Volvo is struggling to ramp up production.
